_**Agent (composer-2.5)**_

Done — a full copy pass across the dashboard. Voice is **utility-first**: say what it is, what to do, skip the lecture.

## Voice guide applied

| Before | After |
|--------|-------|
| Long explanatory paragraphs in tooltips | One sentence, sometimes two — metric + threshold |
| "Owner: Clinician… Manager should follow up…" | Direct roles: "Clinician action" / "Manager: assign" |
| "Click to view details" / "click a segment to drill down" | "View details" / "drill in" |
| Marketing-ish labels ("Care Pathway Throughput") | Plain labels ("Pathway Throughput", "By Type") |

## What changed

**Central tooltips** — Rewrote all 50+ definitions in `kpiDefinitions.ts`. Removed duplicate keys. Examples:
- *Total Cases*: "New child cases registered… One case = one child onboarded."
- *Clinical Pipeline*: "Per assessment, not per child. Tracks assign → score → report → share → goals → approve."

**Tabs** — Shorter nav: Monitoring, Managers, Ops (was Daily Monitoring, Centre Managers, Centre Admins).

**Section headers & subs** — Assessments tab, bottlenecks, monitoring, users — all tightened. Long subs like the Assessments intro went from 3 clauses to one line.

**Action feed** — "Needs Action" (was Action Required). Signal descriptions cut to ~8 words each.

**Role tabs** — Shorter funnel subtitles, queue action notes, and table headers across clinicians, managers, and ops.

**KPI card subs** — "This period", "Clean", "Nothing blocked" instead of full sentences.

**Drill-down hints** — `View details` everywhere.

**Brand** — Top bar reads **Unity Ops**; refresh tooltip says "Auto-refresh" not "Auto-refresh in".

## Scan test

If someone reads **only headings + KPI labels**, they should get:
- **Overview** → volume + what needs action  
- **Monitoring** → who showed up today  
- **Clinicians / Managers / Ops** → workload vs queue  
- **Bottlenecks** → where flow stalls  
- **Assessments** → type → centre → clinician → overdue  

Want me to push further on any tab (e.g. sharper ops language vs softer clinical tone), or walk section-by-section so you can approve before we ship?

---

_**User**_

do a section by section sweep and suggest changes that will make from a normal dashboard to a world class one 

---

_**Agent (composer-2.5)**_

Here is a section-by-section sweep: what you have today, what separates a **good** ops dashboard from a **world-class** one, and concrete changes ranked by impact.

---

## Global shell (TopBar, tabs, filters)

**Today:** Sticky dark header, centre + date range, 8 flat tabs, 1-hour auto-refresh, filters apply globally but aren’t in the URL.

**Gap:** World-class dashboards feel like a *product*, not a report. Context is shareable, navigation matches how people work, and freshness is obvious.

| Priority | Change |
|----------|--------|
| **High** | **URL state** — `?tab=bottlenecks&centre=12&from=2026-04-01`. Lets ops share “look at this” links and survive refresh. |
| **High** | **Reduce tab sprawl** — 8 tabs is a lot. Group into 4 jobs: **Pulse** (overview + monitoring), **Pipeline** (bottlenecks + assessments), **People** (clinicians / managers / ops / users), or use a left nav with sub-sections. |
| **High** | **Filter bar as context chip** — Show active filters as removable chips (“Centre: Pune · Last 30 days”) instead of a blue notice buried below tabs. |
| **Medium** | **Compare periods** — “vs previous period” delta on overview KPIs (↑12% cases, ↓3pp completion). This is the single biggest “insights vs numbers” upgrade. |
| **Medium** | **Saved views** — “My centre · This week”, “Leadership monthly”. Even localStorage presets help power users. |
| **Low** | **Keyboard nav** — `1–8` for tabs, `/` for search, `Esc` closes panels (partially there). |
| **Low** | **Link to DATA-DICTIONARY** — “How is this calculated?” in the header opens your guide. Builds trust. |

---

## Overview

**Today:** Needs Action feed → 7 KPI cards → activity chart + pathway funnel → centre table. Strong structure; ActionFeed is already above average.

**Gap:** Overview should answer in 10 seconds: *Are we healthy? What’s on fire? Where?*

| Priority | Change |
|----------|--------|
| **High** | **One hero score** — e.g. “Pipeline health: 78” combining completion, stuck onboarding, engagement. Sub-metrics support it; they don’t compete with it. |
| **High** | **ActionFeed → direct drill, not tab hop** — “3 stuck onboarding” should open the bottleneck drill-down pre-filtered, not just jump to tab 5. Same for idle clinicians → filtered clinician table. |
| **High** | **Owner on every signal** — Tag each alert: `Manager` / `Clinician` / `Ops`. Your DATA-DICTIONARY already defines roles; the UI should show who acts. |
| **Medium** | **Sparklines on KPI cards** — Tiny 7-day trend under Total Cases / Results. Numbers without trajectory feel static. |
| **Medium** | **Merge or differentiate the two funnels** — “Centre Activity” bar chart and “Pathway Throughput” funnel overlap conceptually. Either combine into one “Volume & conversion” block or make the distinction explicit (activity events vs case progression). |
| **Medium** | **Centre table: rank + anomaly** — Highlight centres that dropped vs last period or are outliers (e.g. high cases, zero results). |
| **Low** | **“All clear” should still show pulse** — When clean, show last period totals or a one-line “782 results · 94% completion” so the page doesn’t feel empty. |

---

## Monitoring

**Today:** Best interactive section — “Who worked today?”, role breakdown with click-to-filter, user table sync, heatmap. This is closer to world-class already.

**Gap:** Daily ops needs *who to call before standup*, not another analytics page.

| Priority | Change |
|----------|--------|
| **High** | **Morning brief card** — Top of tab: “4 need nudge · 2 centres silent · 12 high-activity.” One sentence, then detail. |
| **High** | **Export / share nudge list** — CSV or copy-paste list of inactive users with role + centre for WhatsApp/Slack. Monitoring is actionable when it leaves the dashboard. |
| **Medium** | **Expected vs actual** — “Expected active today” (weekday, role, centre schedule if you have it). “Need nudge” is sharper with an expectation model. |
| **Medium** | **Unify LivePulse + TopBar refresh** — Two freshness indicators (header + monitoring) can disagree. One source of truth, visible everywhere. |
| **Medium** | **Week-over-week on trend chart** — Overlay last week’s actions line. “Tuesday is usually slow” vs “Tuesday is broken.” |
| **Low** | **Rename cards to match funnel language** — “Engagement Rate” vs funnel’s “Did case work” — same concept, different words. Pick one vocabulary. |

---

## Clinicians

**Today:** 5 KPI cards, clinical pipeline funnel (6 steps), centre chart, workload table. Drill-down panels exist.

**Gap:** Managers need *who’s overloaded, who’s stuck, who to reassign* — not another leaderboard.

| Priority | Change |
|----------|--------|
| **High** | **Default sort: risk** — Table sorted by stuck cases + idle + caseload, not alphabetically. World-class ops UIs surface problems first. |
| **High** | **Pipeline funnel: show drop-off % between steps** — You have `% of assigned`; add “−23% lost here” between Scoring → Report PDF. That’s the insight. |
| **High** | **Person row → full profile in one click** — Every clinician name links to `/users/[id]` with filters preserved. Reduce dead-end tables. |
| **Medium** | **Capacity band** — Caseload bands: OK / Watch / Overloaded (thresholds per centre or global). Color the row, not just the number. |
| **Medium** | **CSV export on role drill-down** — Bottleneck panel exports; role panel doesn’t. Parity matters for managers. |
| **Low** | **Yield definition inline** — Small “?” is fine; also show formula once in the section subhead: `results ÷ (results + caseload)`. |

---

## Managers

**Today:** Registration → assignment funnel, assign rate, stuck onboarding, assignment queue table. Clear ops story.

**Gap:** This tab should feel like a **work queue**, not a retrospective report.

| Priority | Change |
|----------|--------|
| **High** | **Queue table as primary** — Move “Assignment queue” above charts when `Unassigned > 0`. Charts are context; the queue is the job. |
| **High** | **SLA countdown in queue** — “Registered 52h ago” in red. Age since registration, not just counts. |
| **High** | **Open in Unity** — Deep link to child case from drill-down (you have `unityPatientUrl`; wire it everywhere drill-down shows a patient). |
| **Medium** | **Manager leaderboard guardrails** — Showing “most registrations” without “most unassigned” encourages wrong behaviour. Pair every productivity metric with a quality metric. |
| **Low** | **Handoff rate target line** — Ring shows 73%; add faint “target 90%” tick on the ring or subtext. |

---

## Ops (Centre Admins)

**Today:** Mirror of Managers for routing: register → route → backlog.

**Gap:** Same as Managers — **queue-first**, **age-aware**, **action-linked**.

| Priority | Change |
|----------|--------|
| **High** | Same queue-first + SLA age + Unity deep links as Managers. |
| **Medium** | **Clarify Ops vs Manager boundary in UI** — One line at top: “Ops routes to clinical · Managers assign to clinicians.” Prevents role confusion (your DATA-DICTIONARY explains it; the tab should too). |
| **Medium** | **Same-day routing trend** — You track the metric on profile KPIs; show it on the Ops tab summary, not only in user drill-down. |

---

## Bottlenecks

**Today:** SLA KPI cards, pipeline funnel, by-centre bars, trend chart, action queue table, rich drill-down with CSV export. One of the strongest tabs.

**Gap:** Bottlenecks should answer *root cause* and *what improved*, not just *what’s stuck*.

| Priority | Change |
|----------|--------|
| **High** | **Single “Total blocked children” headline** — Sum stuck onboarding + pending goals + incomplete assessments as one number with breakdown pills. Executives want one metric; ops want the split. |
| **High** | **Cohort view** — “Of cases registered this week, 62% reached result within 14 days.” Funnel counts events; cohort counts children through time. |
| **Medium** | **Auto-prioritized action queue** — Sort by `(severity × age × centre weight)`, not centre name. |
| **Medium** | **Goal approval: show oldest pending** — “Longest waiting: 6.2 days” on the card. Turnaround average hides outliers. |
| **Low** | **Trend chart annotations** — Mark weeks with holidays or centre closures so SLA spikes aren’t misread. |

---

## Users

**Today:** Summary cards, role/centre breakdown, needs-attention lists, profile drawer.

**Gap:** User directory should be the **CRM for staff health** — searchable, filterable, exportable.

| Priority | Change |
|----------|--------|
| **High** | **Unified search at tab level** — One search across all users, not separate searches in inactive/never-active sections. |
| **High** | **Filters: role, centre, status, last active** — Table-style directory, not only exception lists. |
| **Medium** | **Drawer → full page by default for deep work** — Drawer is fine for peek; “Open full profile” should be obvious. |
| **Medium** | **Bulk actions** — Select users → export / copy emails for follow-up. |
| **Low** | **Align role badge colors** with Clinicians (blue) / Managers (violet) / Ops (teal) everywhere — profile page uses green for manager; inconsistent. |

---

## Assessments

**Today:** Five stacked sections (type cards → completion chart → by centre → matrix → overdue). Comprehensive but long.

**Gap:** World-class assessment ops = **type × centre × person × age** in one scannable surface, with overdue as the alarm.

| Priority | Change |
|----------|--------|
| **High** | **Overdue up top when count > 0** — If 23 overdue, that section should be section 1, expanded, red-accented. Alarm before analytics. |
| **High** | **Matrix: row click → clinician profile filtered to pending** — The matrix is your best diagnostic; make it the hub. |
| **Medium** | **Collapse sections 2–4 by default** — Accordion: “By type (open)” · “By centre” · “By clinician”. Reduces scroll fatigue. |
| **Medium** | **Goal pending on type cards** — You already have `goalApproval` tooltip data; if &gt; 0, show a badge on the card (“3 goals waiting”). Connects assessments to bottlenecks. |
| **Low** | **Benchmark line on completion chart** — Horizontal 80% target across all types. |

---

## User profile (`/users/[id]`)

**Today:** Dedicated page with KPIs, trend, caseload, recent actions. Good separation from main dashboard.

**Gap:** Profile should be the **single pane of glass** for one person’s impact and blockers.

| Priority | Change |
|----------|--------|
| **High** | **“What needs attention” banner** — Stuck cases, pending goals, idle streak at top before KPIs. |
| **High** | **Breadcrumb back with context** — “← Clinicians · Dr Raj · Last 30 days” not just “Back”. |
| **Medium** | **Peer comparison** — “Avg time to result: 2.1d (team avg 3.4d)” — contextualizes performance without shaming. |
| **Low** | **Match dashboard visual system** — Profile uses `bg-[#F7F8FA]`; main app uses `bg-gray-50`. Small but breaks polish. |

---

## Cross-cutting (what world-class products always do)

These apply everywhere and often matter more than new charts.

### 1. Insight layer (not more widgets)
- Every metric: **value · target · trend · owner**
- Every alert: **what · who · next step · link**

### 2. Action closure
- Wire **Unity deep links** on every patient row in drill-downs (infrastructure exists; adoption is uneven).
- **CSV export** on all drill-down panels, not only bottlenecks.
- Optional: “Copy summary for Slack” on Needs Action feed.

### 3. Trust & definitions
- **“As of 14:32 · refreshes hourly”** on Overview (Monitoring already feels live).
- Link KPI tooltips to **DATA-DICTIONARY** anchors (`#onboarding`, `#caseload`).
- Show **period label** on every chart subtitle (“Last 30 days”, not implicit).

### 4. Visual system
- You’re 80% there (Plus Jakarta, rounded-2xl cards, consistent rings). To go world-class:
  - **One severity language** everywhere: Critical / Watch / OK (same colors, same words).
  - **Reduce card chrome** on secondary blocks — let tables breathe; reserve shadows for interactive KPIs.
  - **Semantic color only for status** — charts can stay multi-color; alerts should be rose/amber/emerald only.

### 5. Information architecture (biggest structural win)

Current mental model is **by data type** (8 tabs). World-class ops tools organize by **job**:

```
Pulse          → Overview + Monitoring (is today OK?)
Pipeline       → Bottlenecks + Assessments (where are cases stuck?)
People         → Clinicians, Managers, Ops, Users (who owns the work?)
```

Same components, clearer story. Linear, Stripe Atlas, and Vercel’s internal tools all converge on *fewer top-level destinations, richer pages*.

---

## Suggested rollout (if you want to implement)

**Week 1 — highest ROI**
1. URL + filter chips  
2. ActionFeed → direct drill-down + owner tags  
3. Overdue-first on Assessments  
4. Unity links on all drill-down patient rows  
5. CSV export on role drill-down  

**Week 2 — insight**
6. Period comparison deltas on Overview KPIs  
7. Queue-first layout on Managers/Ops when backlog &gt; 0  
8. Morning brief on Monitoring  

**Week 3 — architecture**
9. Tab regroup or left nav  
10. Cohort funnel on Bottlenecks  

---

## What you already do well (don’t lose this)

- **Needs Action feed** with severity, centres, and navigation — many dashboards never get this far.
- **Click-through funnels** with drill-down panels — rare in internal tools.
- **Monitoring engagement funnel → filtered table** — genuinely excellent interaction design.
- **Role-specific queues** (manager assign vs ops route vs clinician workload) — correctly separated in data and copy.
- **DATA-DICTIONARY** — world-class teams document metrics; most don’t.

---

If you want to go from review to build, tell me which track to start with: **quick wins (Week 1)**, **IA/tab restructure**, or **one tab deep-dive** (I’d pick Overview or Bottlenecks first). I can implement in that order.
